incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered PD#INC-427112 -> region: us-west-az2 | symptom: sudden 5xx surge + ingress packet errors | severity: P1
PagerDuty: Paging rotation: @oncall-sre, @Priya K, @Jamal (auto-remind 45s)
Priya K: ack'd at 03:12:14 UTC. grabbing dashboards and runbook for zone-network-degradation.
Jamal: I'm available to help with routing changes. pulling netflow for az2 now.
Theo M: infra telemetry showing NIC drop counters climbing on us-west-az2 hosts (nic1), BGP adjacency flaps seen around 03:10 UTC. Frontend proxies returning 502/504.
oncall-sre: Runbook step 1: confirm extent. `kubectl -n serving get endpoints -l zone=az2` and `haproxy stats` checks started.
Marta: Customer telemetry: tenant bucket 'enterprise-s' sees ~25% error rate starting 03:09:30 UTC. CS queue flagged 12 tickets in 8m.
Priya K: Pod health mostly Ready but app-level latencies >2s. Kernel counters show rx_overruns; opening cloud support ticket.
incident-bot: Auto-suggest: Consider progressive traffic diversion off us-west-az2 if NIC errors persist >5m. Suggested initial divert: 30% to us-west-az1 with 5m observe window. Requires manual approve.
Jamal: I approve progressive diversion. Executing: `redwoodctl routing divert --from=us-west-az2 --to=us-west-az1 --percent=30 --ramp=2m --note='az2 nic errors'`
Theo M: Diversion in flight; routing metrics show 31% of new sessions routed to us-west-az1. Expect cache miss penalty ~120ms and some KV rehydrate load.
Marta: Posting interim status to status.redwood.com/incidents/427112 — message: investigating network interface errors in us-west-az2; diverting part of traffic to us-west-az1; impact to some tenants (enterprise-s, beta-trial)
Customer Support Bot: Posted update and started targeted outreach to affected tenants.
Priya K: Also enabling model-bypass for short TTL requests to reduce retry storms: `routing-rule: if path==/v1/generate and latency>1000ms -> model=fallback-small`
Jamal: After initial divert, global 5xx decreased from 25% to ~6% over 6 minutes. However cpu on az1 proxies climbed ~20%. Scaling az1 serving pool by +25% now: `infra autoscale --zone=az1 --component=serving --scale=+25%`
Theo M: Cloud provider opened ticket CP-9921; they report NIC firmware issue being rolled across hosts in az2; ETA 20-40m for full remediation.
Marta: CS will update affected customers every 15 minutes. Increasing trace retention for the incident window for triage.
Priya K: Suppressing PD re-alerts for 20m while we monitor. I'll remain primary oncall until we observe a stable 10m window with <2% 5xx.
Lewis: ack. I'll prepare for handoff and monitor KV cache rehydration metrics — recommend staggering rollback to avoid a cache-thundering event.
oncall-sre: Noted — implement staggered reduce: `redwoodctl routing divert --from=us-west-az2 --to=us-west-az1 --percent=decrease:5m:5%` when provider signals healthy.
Jamal: Creating short-term mitigation summary: 1) diverted ~30% to az1, 2) applied short-request fallback model, 3) scaled az1 by +25%, 4) engaged cloud for NIC firmware reset. Visible error rates improving.
Priya K: Action items before handoff: continue monitoring provider ticket, keep CS cadence, validate that error rate stays <2% for 10 contiguous minutes, then start controlled rewind of diversion.
Marta: Drafting incident skeleton for postmortem; collecting affected customer list and earliest error timestamp.
incident-bot: PD#INC-427112 acknowledged by Priya K at 03:12:45 UTC. Escalation timer paused.
Lewis: I'll take over at 03:30 UTC if we hit stability. Please notify if any regression.
Jamal: Noted, keeping an eye on az1 load and autoscaler events.
Priya K: Locking runbook: mitigation in progress. Remaining watch items: provider confirmation, cache rehydrate metrics, and support ticket churn.
incident-bot: Thread marked resolved for active paging at 03:27:30 UTC (mitigation engaged). Continue updates in new thread or DM to oncall.
